_about: Windows event descriptions keyed by (provider, EventID). Provider names are matched case-insensitively, with or without the 'Microsoft-Windows-' prefix; 'aliases' maps legacy event-source names (what the live parser sees) to provider names. 'about' says what a provider is, used when its ID has no entry. %1..%n are filled from the event's inserts / EventData values in order. Rules are data: edit this file, not the parsers. Used by utils/event_descriptions.py.
